mara-tryner.popis: I've lived for cycling since I was young – my parents led me to it, or rather, bikes were never missing in our family and accompanied me throughout my childhood, whether it was a folding bike, a BMX, an MTB or a road bike. I got into cycle trial at 14, when I saw someone jumping on a bike over benches for the first time in my life. It was Michal Budský on a 20” bike. All at a time when I was racing MTB for Cykloprag Praha. Since then I've been hooked on cycle trial, and Michal Budský became my teacher.< I started on my old 26” Scott Vail MTB, which took a real beating during my first steps in trial. Suspension fork, chainrings, derailleur – basically everything went to pieces. In the end I bought an old, cracked 20” trial bike for about CZK 6,000, and since then I've gone through about 4 more bikes. In the following years, while studying at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Brno, I switched to 26” bikes and gradually started riding cycle trial under the UCI, or rather the Czech Cycling Federation. In 2008 I founded my own online shop for trial components, which still operates today and which I keep trying to move forward. It also allows me to test new components, and I try to pass my experience on to customers so that everything suits them as well as possible. I don't sell….I help. In 2015 I joined the Czech national team, i.e. the national cycle trial squad, and took part in the European Championships in Italy and France. A great experience! In 2016 I managed to beat my trial teacher in the Czech Championship. There was no rivalry between us, but I was honestly glad that he had passed his experience on to me so well that I could use it even against him. I'll never forget that. Thank you! What next? It's time to pass my experience on in turn….. RESULTS2014 – runner-up in the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2015 – winner of the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2016 – winner of the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2016 – runner-up at the Czech Championship, Elite 26” categoryMember of the Czech national team and many other results and sporting achievements … ‍

katarina-tothova.popis: I started mountain biking at 15. Shortly after that I got into a downhill team and, with almost no experience, started racing straight away. Then I added four-cross, BMX racing and, in the last few years, enduro. I've raced in the Czech Cup and the World Cup. After almost 20 years on the bike, I love passing my experience on, whether to kids, men or women – and I love giving women the courage to see that you can have fun on a bike and that you can ride down anything. Even so, I keep trying to improve on the bike as much as time and my kids allow. RESULTS 2007 – national downhill champion 2008 – national downhill champion 2008 – national runner-up in four-cross 2008 – 6th place at the four-cross World Cup in Andorra Member of the Czech national downhill team

lukas-valny.popis: Luky is another one of those who can't write a few lines about himself for his profile. A stubborn, pumped-up pocket-sized man capable of big jumps – and big crashes. He's considered our club's biggest die-hard in terms of work done, hours ridden and jumps crashed. Like Petr Jeřicha, Luky grew up on the bike alongside Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and worked his way up from village Trial rider to newcomer in the Elite category on 20″ trial bikes. He started at a later age, but he's clear proof that with regular training alongside better riders you can reach a decent level quickly and painlessly. He's into a whole range of other sports, including the opposite sex. After a short break and a one-year drop to the Expert category, he fulfilled his dream and won the Czech amateur championship title. RESULTSCzech champion, EXPERT categoryCzech runner-up, EXPERT categoryWinner of the 2015 OPEN FREE series4th place at the indoor cup in Germanyand many wins at Czech Cup races and open races ‍

martin-simunek.popis: “Šimon” is one of the legends of the trial sport – a three-time world champion of the BIU (Biketrial) federation in the era before the world's riders left and the sport practically died out – and one of the most successful Trial representatives under the Czech Cycling Federation (UCI), winning the title of UCI world runner-up. Martin truly reached the very top of the Trial sport by competing at the world championships of both disciplines. Racing is no longer a priority for him, but even so he took second place in the 2011 Czech Trial Cup under the Czech Cycling Federation and won a number of Trial contests. Besides racing, he has collected and keeps collecting records on bikes – his biggest, still unbeaten record is riding up the Petřín lookout tower by hopping up the stairs, setting a time of 6:18 min on 30 March 1993. Today Martin focuses on exhibition performances and organising sports, cultural and social events as part of the TRIALSHOW.cz team. He can handle everything from hosting to management and logistics. He's a leading figure and a motivation for many riders, from beginners to the best Czech professional riders. RESULTS11x Czech champion6x Czech indoor championUCI world runner-up3x BIU world champion (back when that title was worth fighting for)and many more results that our screen resolution wouldn't be enough for … ‍

vlasta.popis:
... whom nobody on the team calls anything but Čihi, is one of the most successful Czech Trial riders of the professional UCI federation, taught to ride by riders such as Martin Šimůnek, Josef Dressler and Roman Chvojka. He comes from the birthplace of the Czech trial sport, Říčany near Prague. He lives in Tehov, where he has some of the best conditions for his own training and that of his club colleagues.


Čihi currently rides for POC helmets, MALOJA, LEZYNE, GATORADE and TM Servis – the technical motion. Vlasta proudly rides for the MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany club.


RESULTS

Čihi has several times been the highest-ranked Czech rider in the UCI ranking – in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014 and 2016 in the Elite 26´´ category (20´´ only in some years).

Czech champion 2012, 2013, 2015, 2016, 2017

Czech indoor champion 2013

Czech champion in jumps on a 26″ mountain bike 2017, 2018

Czech champion in jumps on a 20″ trial bike 2017,

Unofficial Czech champion in ENDURO TRIAL 2014, 2018

Winner of the Czech Trial Cup 2010, 2011, 2012

Winner of the UCI European Cup 2010

Second place at C1 category races 2015 and 2016

Winner of the TRIAL cup 2011 and 2012, 12th place at the UCI European Championships 2015

2nd place in the Czech Trial Cup 2002,

3rd at the Czech Championship – ČSC Trial 2003,

6-time Czech record holder

Guinness record holder for hopping up and riding down the Petřín lookout tower

Two years in a row he made it into the TOP 20 professionals at the World Championships, and as the first Czech rider he was invited to the TrialPro series for the world's top 20 riders.

1st place at Říčany Trial – Reborn,

15th place at the UCI European Championships 2011,

17th place in the World Cup 2009 and 19th place in 2008, and many more results …
